observations: Matched ORD product is ClC1=C(C=CC(=C1)O)CSC1=NC(=CC(=N1)O)C, corresponding to replacement of the aryl methoxy group by hydroxyl.

entities.name: BBr3 O-demethylation
observations: Matched reaction uses BBr3, water, and dichloromethane; reaction time 8 hours and reported yield 13%. The record's reagent/catalyst field lists dichloromethane despite BBr3 appearing among reactants.
